content_harvesting.sublines: Multi-Criteria Dijkstra with Hard Terrain Ceilings in Swift 6
talking_points: calculateCost returns nil whenever edge.difficulty > query.maxDifficulty, so an intermediate skier at Lone Peak Summit receives nil instead of a route down Big Couloir.
Soft surface multipliers (0.8x groomed bonus, 2.5x ungroomed penalty, 5.0x mogul penalty) weight trail choice without relaxing ability limits.
An array-backed binary MinHeap over cached C-SQLite3 statements solves a 305-node, 607-edge mountain fixture in 0.418 ms offline.
